title: 第一卷 第10章 圣阳功法
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

生死关头，顾不得许多。

叶笙歌依照图谱所示姿势坐好，摒弃杂念，回忆中医经络知识，尝试感应所谓的“丹田”。

然后，用意念引导，想象一股热流，沿着手臂肺经，冲向大拇指末端的少商穴。

起初毫无感觉，只有伤口的剧痛和麻木。但他没有放弃，集中全部精神，反复尝试。

就在他几乎要昏厥时，左肩伤口处，那麻木阴寒的感觉，似乎被一丝极其微弱的暖意触碰了一下。

紧接着，他感到自己右手拇指尖的少商穴，微微发热，仿佛有一点极其凝聚的“热量”在那里盘旋。

他精神一振，继续引导。

那点暖意渐渐增强，从少商穴逆流而上，沿着手臂经络，流向肩头伤口。

所过之处，麻痹感退去，反而有一种灼热却舒畅的感觉。

伤口处的青黑色变淡，流出黑色的毒血也逐渐转为鲜红。那股阴寒的毒性，竟真的被这奇异的热流驱散化解了！

叶笙歌心中震撼无比。这《圣阳功法》第一式“少商引阳”，竟有如此奇效！

他不敢停歇，持续运转这简陋的法门，直到肩头伤口只余下正常的疼痛，再无麻木感，全身的寒意和眩晕也彻底消失。

他长吁一口气，瘫倒在床上，沉沉睡去。

不知睡了多久，他被轻微的敲门声惊醒。睁眼，天色已大亮。

他动了动左肩，伤口依然疼，但已无大碍，体内毒素竟已清除得七七八八。

“叶公公，你醒了吗？”是兰心的声音，带着担忧。

叶笙歌起身，迅速检查了一下自己，换了件干净中衣，遮住伤口，才道：“进来吧。”

兰心推门而入，见他虽然脸色还有些苍白，但精神明显好了许多，肩头简单包扎过的布条也只有淡淡血迹，不由惊喜：“公公，你……你没事了？”

“侥幸，用了家传的解毒法子，已无大碍。”叶笙歌淡淡道。

兰心和闻讯赶来的冯安见他确实好转，都松了口气，连连称奇。

消息很快传到苏清婉那里，她正应付着皇帝的再次探视，闻言，拿着茶盏的手抖了一下，心中一块大石落地。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At the moment of life and death, there is not much to worry about.

Ye Shengge sat in the posture shown in the chart, put aside distracting thoughts, recalled the knowledge of traditional Chinese medicine meridians, and tried to sense the so-called "Dan Tian".

Then, use your mind to guide you and imagine a stream of heat rushing along the lung meridian of your arm towards the Shaoshang point at the end of your thumb.

At first there was no feeling, just sharp pain and numbness from the wound.But he didn't give up, concentrated all his energy, and tried again and again.

Just when he was about to faint, the numb and cold feeling at the wound on his left shoulder seemed to be touched by an extremely weak warmth.

Immediately afterwards, he felt that the Shaoshang point on the tip of his right thumb was slightly warm, as if there was an extremely concentrated "heat" hovering there.

He perked up and continued to guide.

The warmth gradually increased, flowing upstream from the Shaoshang point, along the meridians of the arm, and towards the wound on the shoulder.

Wherever he passed, the numbness subsided, and instead he felt a burning but comfortable feeling.

The green and black color at the wound became lighter, and the black poisonous blood flowing out gradually turned into bright red.The cold toxicity was really dispelled by this strange heat flow!

Ye Shengge was extremely shocked.The first form of "Shengyang Kung Fu", "Shao Shang Yin Yang", has such a miraculous effect!

He didn't dare to stop and continued to use this simple method until the wound on his shoulder only had normal pain, no numbness anymore, and the chill and dizziness in his body completely disappeared.

He took a long breath, collapsed on the bed, and fell into a deep sleep.

Not knowing how long he had slept, he was awakened by a slight knock on the door.Open your eyes, the sky is already bright.

He moved his left shoulder. The wound still hurt, but it was no longer serious. The toxins in his body had been completely eliminated.

"Eunuch Ye, are you awake?" It was Lan Xin's voice, filled with worry.

Ye Shengge stood up, quickly checked himself, changed into a clean middle coat, covered the wound, and then said, "Come in."

Lan Xin pushed the door open and saw that although his face was still a little pale, his energy was obviously much better. The cloth bandage on his shoulder had only a faint trace of blood. She couldn't help but be surprised: "Father-in-law, you...are you okay?"

"Luckily, after using the detoxification method passed down from our family, there is no serious problem." Ye Shengge said calmly.

Lan Xin and Feng An, who came after hearing the news, were relieved and amazed when they saw that he had indeed improved.

The news quickly reached Su Qingwan. She was dealing with the emperor's visit again. When she heard this, the hand holding the tea cup shook, and a big stone fell in her heart.
